ukraine-strikes-bridge.title: Russia continues striking Ukraine, destroying homes and power networks ahead of winter
ukraine-strikes-bridge.summary: Media reports describe new Russian strikes on Ukraine, including attacks on residential buildings and energy infrastructure, as winter approaches. Al Jazeera says at least 15 people were killed in a series of attacks; Ukrainian outlets report a fire and seven injuries in Lozova. In Dymer, Kyiv region, Meduza and El País report that 11 people were killed after a strike on a five-story building, while a child was pulled alive from the rubble. Some reports also highlight the war expanding beyond the region, but the focus of this roundup is the strikes on Ukraine and their consequences for civilians.
